description: This file manages email reminders within a workflow system, including scheduling, sending, and deleting email reminders based on events or form submissions, with integration to external services like Prisma, tasker, and custom templates.

classes.name: WorkflowReminderRepository
classes.description: Repository class for managing workflow reminder data in the database.

classes.name: EmailWorkflowService
classes.description: Service class for generating email payloads related to workflow events.

methods.name: sendOrScheduleWorkflowEmailWithReminder
methods.description: Sends an email immediately or schedules it for later, creating a reminder record if scheduled.

methods.name: scheduleEmailReminder
methods.description: Schedules an email reminder based on event or form data, with verification.

methods.name: scheduleEmailReminderForEvt
methods.description: Handles scheduling email reminders for specific events, considering timing and past date checks.

methods.name: scheduleEmailReminderForForm
methods.description: Handles sending email reminders immediately based on form submission data.

methods.name: deleteScheduledEmailReminder
methods.description: Deletes or cancels a scheduled email reminder, handling both tasker and database cleanup.
